user.title: Connect your BAPP Auto account
user.description: Paste the personal API token from the BAPP Auto app (Settings → Integrations → Home Assistant). Every car you own or that was shared with you becomes a device.

data_description.token: A UUID like 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000. It is stored only in Home Assistant.
data_description.host: Leave the default unless you run your own bapp server.

reauth_confirm.title: Token rejected
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {host} no longer works. Generate a new one in the BAPP Auto app and paste it here.

error.invalid_auth: The token was rejected. Check it or generate a new one in the app.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log.

data_description.scan_interval: Documents change rarely; 30 minutes is plenty. Minimum 5.

update_mileage.name: Update mileage
update_mileage.description: Sets the odometer value of a car in BAPP Auto.

mileage.name: Mileage
mileage.description: The full odometer value in km. Values with 3 digits or fewer are treated by the server as the last three digits of the current mileage.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Fetches the latest cars and documents right away instead of waiting for the next poll.

not_a_car.message: Device {device_id} is not a BAPP Auto car.

entry_not_loaded.message: The BAPP Auto integration is not loaded.
